_readme: One source for every trade on the site. A trade with "listing" links to its page (src/data/listings/<listing>.json). A trade without "listing" shows as coming soon. To add a trade: add its listing JSON, then put its key in "listing" here. Group order and trade order here is the order on the site.

groups.name: Repairs
groups.line: Roofs, leaks, wiring and repairs around the home
groups.intro: Trades for repairs around the home: a leaking roof, a dripping pipe, a tripping fuse board or a lock that will not turn.

groups.name: Improvements
groups.line: Building work, kitchens, bathrooms and decorating
groups.intro: Trades for bigger projects that change your home: extensions, loft conversions, new kitchens and bathrooms, and decorating.

groups.name: Outdoor
groups.intro: Trades for the outside of your home: gardens, driveways and patios, fences and trees.

groups.name: Cleaning & Services
groups.line: Cleaning, removals, waste and pest control
groups.intro: Services that keep a home running: cleaning, moving house, clearing waste and dealing with pests.

groups.name: Specialist
groups.line: Asbestos, damp, drainage and other specialist work
groups.intro: Specialist trades for jobs that need particular training or equipment, such as asbestos, damp and drainage.
